LESSON: THE COUNTY GOVERNMENTS IN KENYA

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.7: The County Governments in Kenya

SECTION 2: TEACHING CONTENT

” to allow audio playback QUALITIES OF GOOD CITIZENSHIP IN SCHOOL Music Hallo learner, welcome to a social studies lesson grade 4 . Today we shall learn about qualities of good citizenship in school. Your radio teacher is Eugene Kimani. Welcome to the programme Music

” to allow audio playback Hallo learner, welcome to our social studies grade 4 lesson. Today we shall learn about qualities of good citizenship in school. So get your book and pencil and let us learn social studies. I am your radio teacher Eugene Kimani. Music I hope you have the book and pen ready and set to learn. We are going to start the lesson by remembering what we learnt about community leadership in our county. What does a community leader do in the county? Music I hope you were able to answer what a community leader does. Very good . A community leader: Teaches people about good values in the society. Examples of values are honesty, loyalty, kindness, truthfulness and so on. Community leader solves problems in the community. They guide people to know what is right and wrong. They lead people in prayers and worship. They make sure the culture and traditions of the community are not forgotten. They lead people in cultural events in the community. Now that we have said what a community leader does, Let’s get to today’s topic. We shall talk about qualities of good citizenship in school. Now who is a citizen? Music Very good, a citizen is a person who belongs to a particular place or country. Now let us look at what is citizenship? Citizenship is the act of belonging to a country and enjoying the rights that the citizens of that country enjoy. What can you do in school to make you a good learner? Answer when you hear the music Music Very good, we do things like: Help one another in doing various things. Keeping the school clean. Being at peace with others at all times. Sharing with one another. What are some the good qualities of learners in school? Answer when you hear the music. Music Very good, I hope you have said some of the qualities. I will now say some good qualities of learners in school. A good learner should be kind to others. A good learner should be honest. A good learner should be caring. A good learner should be obedient. A good learner should be responsible. A good learner should be hardworking. A good learner should be humble. A good learner should be tolerant. You can mention more if you have any.

” to allow audio playback I am now going to read out qualities of a learner. Write down if you hear any bad qualities of a learner. Are you ready? Here I go. Kind; disobedient; honest; lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. I repeat, write down if you hear any bad quality of a learner. Here I go. Kind; disobedient; honest; lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Did you write the bad qualities that you have heard? Music Very good, from our list, the following are the bad qualities of a bad learner. Disobedient, lazy, rude, irresponsible, a bully, greedy and selfish. Before doing something, we should always ask ourselves the following questions. Question 1 Will my teacher be happy with what I am going to do? Question 2 Will my parents be happy with what I am going to do? Question 3 Will what I am going to do help other learners in school? Question 4 Will what I am going to do help me do well in school? When we practice good citizenship in school, there is good performance. Things in school are taken well care of and there is peace and harmony. I am now going to read out good qualities of a learner. Write down if you hear any qualities of a good learner. Are you ready? Here I go. Kind, disobedient, honest, lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Did you write the good qualities that you have heard? Let me read them again. Kind, disobedient, honest, lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Music I hope you have written the following words: Kind, honest, caring, tolerant, hardworking and humble. Learner, show how you can be a good child at home. With that, we have now come to the end of the lesson for today.

It was produced by Zachary Kago for Educational Media Directorate, Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development. Until next time, Goodbye. Music

” to allow audio playback ASPECTS OF TRADITIONAL CULTURE IN THE COUNTY [Music] Hallo learner, welcome to social studies for grade 4. Today we will talk about aspects of traditional culture in the county. Your radio teacher is Esther Simaloi. Welcome to the program [Music]

” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner, welcome to our social studies lesson. Today we are going to learn about the aspects of traditional culture and tell how culture is expressed in our county. Culture is the way of life of people in our community. Culture is the way of life of people in a community. What is community #Bell# A Community is a group of people living in a particular local area they interact together in their day to day life they share a common belief and values. in the past each community had its special way of life a way of doing things that is different from others. This is what we call culture or tradition. Which is your community? Which is your community? #Bell# From which county is your community? From which county is your community? #Bell# Culture was the way of life of the people in the past and is still the way of people in the present. What aspect of your culture were practiced in the past and are still practiced in the present? How do you show your culture today? #Bell# Different communities have different cultures they show their culture in the way they do their things for example: The kind of food they eat. The kind of food they eat. The kind they wear. The clothes they wear. The houses they live in. The houses they live in. The way they conduct their ceremonies such as marriage initiation and naming ceremonies Which cultural foods did people in your community eat? Which cultural foods did people in your community eat? #Bell# Which materials did people in your community use to built their houses? Which materials did people in your community use to built their houses? #Bell# Learner, do you still eat the foods that people in your community ate in the past today? #Bell# Other ways in which people expressed their culture are; through games and sports they played for entertainment Do you play games with your friends Which games do you play that people in your community used to play? #Bell#

” to allow audio playback Culture is expressed through music and dance. Do you sing and dance? Do you sing and dance? #Bell# Sing and dance to your favourite song. I hope it was a traditional song, sang by the people in your community. Traditional songs and dances communicated different important messages. They were also good for entertainment. Songs were sang on different occasions. Name such occasions. #Bell# Good: We have victory songs sang after victory in a war, wedding ceremony songs, naming ceremony songs and initiation ceremony songs The other way people expressed their culture is by the ceremonies they held to mark major events in their lives this include; 1. Naming ceremonies 2. Wedding ceremonies 3. Initiation ceremonies Learner have you taken part in any ceremony in your community? #Bell# Which one was it? Why did they have that ceremony? #Bell# Some traditional aspects are still practiced today. Identify the aspects of culture that you still practice today in your community. #Bell# Good : I hope your answers include; the foods we eat, our dressing or music and dance. Are their aspects of your culture that you do not practice today in your community? #Bell# Why don't we practice the cultural aspects? #Bell# Culture is important because; It identifies who we are It helps us to learn other people's culture It attracts tourists Different aspects of culture help us to learn more about the culture of other people these in turn promote appreciation of other people's culture. To conclude, it is good to note that in the past people carried out their day to day activities differently these activities became the practices and later this practices became the culture of the people, the way of life. Ask your parents, guardians and grandparents to teach you a traditional song performed in a traditional ceremony in your community. That brings us to the end of our lesson today. Until next time, Goodbye.

” to allow audio playback RESOURCES IN THE COUNTY  Music Hello Learner, Welcome to social studies for grade 4. Today we shall talk about resources in the county. We shall talk about resources in the county. Your radio teacher is Esther Simaloi. Welcome to the program.  Music

” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner. Welcome to our social studies lesson. In this lesson we shall learn about resources in the county. We shall also learn how we can conserve the resources in our County. Learner, What are resources? What are resources? #Bell# Resources are things around us that we can use to create wealth. These are things we can use to earn a living. Examples of resources are; Soil, soil Water, water Wildlife, wildlife Land, land Minerals, minerals Forests, forests Can you identify any resources in your area? #Bell# Different Counties have different resources Which is the main resource in your county? Which is the main resource in your county? #Bell# Where do we get this resources? Where do we get this resources? #Bell# This resources are natural resources. Natural means God made. These are things that have not been made by man. Let us discuss some of these resources. WATER Where do you get water in your area? Where do you get water in your area? #Bell# Well done. I hope your answers include we get water from rivers, lakes and dams. We also collect water when it rains and store it in tanks for later use. Learner, which river is found in your county. Which river is found in your county? #Bell# Rivers and lakes provide us with water. People use water to: Drink Wash clothes and clean utensils and To take a bath, to take a bath Farmers use water to grow crops and give animals water to drink. In dry areas, we practice irrigation; this is using water to grow crops.

” to allow audio playback ANOTHER RESOURCE IS WILDLIFE. Wildlife refers to all the animals, birds and plants that are found in their natural environment. These natural environments include forest and water Which wild animals are found in your county? Which wild animals are found in your county? #Bell# Well done . I hope your answers include: 1. Lions. 2. Zebras. 3. Giraffes. 4. Rhinos. 5. Buffaloes. 6. Snakes. 7. Hyenas. 8. Elephants. 9. Wild beasts. 10. Hippos among many more. Learner, How does Wildlife help us to earn a living? How does Wildlife help us to earn a living? #Bell# Well done. Wild animals attract tourists. Tourists bring money to our country Who is a tourist? #Bell# A tourist is a person who travels from one place to another for pleasure. They visit places to; Interact with people to learn their culture. To watch birds and animals in their natural environment. They also visit places to see the beautiful sites and historic built environment. 3. FOREST ARE ANOTHER RESOURCE IN THE COUNTY Learner, what is a forest? #Bell# A forest is a large area covered by trees growing close together. Forests are mainly found in areas that receive a lot of rainfall. Some forests grow naturally while others are planted by people. The following are importance of forests. Forest provide home for wild animals Forest prevent soil erosion Trees in the forest provide us with wood used to make paper and furniture. Forest help us purify or clean up the air we breathe. Learner , How can we conserve the resources found in the county? How can we conserve the resources found in the county? #Bell# Resources can be conserved in the following ways. To conserve is to take good care of something while still using it. use water sparingly to avoid wastage. Use water sparingly to avoid wastage. Avoid cutting trees unnecessarily, when we cut a tree we should plant two for each cut tree. Conserve soil by planting trees to avoid soil erosion. Conserve soil by planting trees to avoid soil erosion To conserve wildlife stop poaching. To conserve wildlife stop poaching To conclude our lesson write a short report about the main resources in your county. And how you can conserve them. That marks the end of our lesson today. Until next time. Goodbye.
